title: Neodani Fault quiz
description: After watching "The ground an earthquake lifted over a century ago: can you still see it?", do you remember how the fault at Midori moved?

questions.question: How far did the 1891 Nōbi earthquake lift the ground at Midori?
questions.explanation: The fault pushed the ground up by about 6 metres, roughly two storeys.

questions.question: How did the fault at Midori move?
options: About 6 m up and about 4 m sideways at the same time
questions.explanation: It is an oblique fault, with both vertical and horizontal movement.

questions.question: More than a century later, what does the fault look like from outside?
questions.explanation: The step is still there, but it is covered in plants; without a sign you could walk past it.
